lines: d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Tom Anderson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d14: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d14: 🕯️ Tom Anderson is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d14: What Tom kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d14: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Fernanda blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d14: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Tom Anderson, 14 days. The mantle passes to Fernanda Zárate.
d14: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Fernanda Zárate, 20 — an exterminator. Her hands know different work now: Bloodhound.
d14: The village's quarrel was with Tom — and Tom is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d14: The fire knew Fernanda — solid ground, earned at this fire.
